fonrex_treasury_curve.name: Fonrex Treasury Curve
fonrex_treasury_curve.description: US Treasury yield curve of a day, 1 month to 30 years, with the curves of 1 month and 1 year before by default; nominal (par yields) or real (TIPS)

params.label: Curve
params.description: Nominal par yields or real yields (TIPS)

params.label: Date
params.description: Day of the curve (the latest when empty)

params.label: Compare with
params.description: Days to compare with, separated by commas: 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y before, or dates

fonrex_treasury_spread.name: Fonrex Treasury Spread
fonrex_treasury_spread.description: US Treasury 10-year minus 2-year spread over time (below zero, the curve is inverted), or other maturities and spreads; last 10 years by default

params.label: Maturities
params.description: Maturities (10Y) or spreads of two (10Y-2Y), separated by commas

params.label: Start
params.description: First day (10 years ago when empty)

fonrex_cot_positioning.name: Fonrex COT Positioning
fonrex_cot_positioning.description: CFTC Commitments of Traders: net position of a type of trader in a futures market (the speculators by default) and its COT index (0 to 100 over a window of weeks), report by report; last 3 years by default

params.label: Market
params.description: CFTC contract market code (GET /cot/markets lists them)

params.label: Report
params.description: Legacy (every market since 1986), TFF (financial markets since 2006) or Disaggregated (commodities since 2006)

params.label: Type of trader
params.description: Empty: the speculators of the report (leveraged funds, managed money, non-commercial)

params.label: Window (weeks)
params.description: Weeks of the COT index window (156: three years)

params.label: Start
params.description: First report date (3 years ago when empty)

fonrex_cot_extremes.name: Fonrex COT Extremes
fonrex_cot_extremes.description: CFTC Commitments of Traders: latest positioning of the key markets of a report, the most extreme first (COT index near 0 or 100), with the net position, its share of the open interest and its weekly change

params.label: Report
params.description: Legacy (every market since 1986), TFF (financial markets since 2006) or Disaggregated (commodities since 2006)

params.label: Markets
params.description: CFTC contract market codes separated by commas (the key markets of the report when empty)

params.label: Type of trader
params.description: Empty: the speculators of the report (leveraged funds, managed money, non-commercial)

params.label: Window (weeks)
params.description: Weeks of the COT index window (156: three years)

fonrex_factor_exposure.name: Fonrex Factor Exposure
fonrex_factor_exposure.description: Exposure of a listing to the Fama/French factors (Kenneth French Data Library): alpha, betas with t-stats, R², on returns in US dollars

params.label: Ticker
params.description: Ticker of a listing with stored daily prices (e.g. AAPL, AIR.PA)

params.label: Model
params.description: ff3 (market, size, value), ff5 (plus profitability, investment), carhart (ff3 plus momentum)

params.label: Frequency
params.description: Monthly (60 months) or daily (252 days) returns

fonrex_factor_returns.name: Fonrex Factor Returns

params.label: Dataset
params.description: Region and factors

params.label: Frequency
params.description: Monthly or daily returns

params.label: Start
params.description: First period (10 years ago when empty)
